key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1432
name: read_key_in_range_animated
description: On first use it allocates and initialises a cursor record, then loops animating a four-phase cursor glyph while polling a key through helper routines. It returns when the key code lies between the two bounds given as arguments, or is Escape or Return; the flag argument selects an extra cursor glyph per pass.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1516
name: wait_for_key_within_bounds
description: Loops drawing a four-phase cursor and polling a key until the key is Escape, Return, or lies between the two bounds passed in. Before returning it stores the high byte of a stack argument into a status field.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:15C2
name: draw_three_stat_fields
description: Draws three fields in fixed columns, each at a row chosen from the argument plus a fixed offset when its corresponding flag byte is set, otherwise from a fixed default row. The last field's return value is passed back to the caller.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1690
name: invoke_setup_then_stored_handler
description: Calls a helper on a fixed table entry, then returns the result of a second helper called on a pointer stored in the data block. It is a short two-step dispatch.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:16AC
name: swap_pairs_and_test_match
description: Swaps two adjacent pairs of stored bytes, then clears a flag at a fixed offset when three of the compared bytes match their stored counterparts. It tracks a rolling input state.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:16F6
name: lookup_threshold_bucket_entry
description: Compares a 16-bit argument against thresholds 10, 20, 50, 100 and 500, selects one of six fixed table entries for that bucket, and returns the helper's result for that entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1716
name: call_threshold_bucket_entry
description: Uses a 16-bit value to choose one of five fixed table entries by thresholds of 10, 20, 50 and 100, then passes that entry to a helper with no return value. Values of 100 or more select the top entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1728
name: call_small_threshold_bucket_entry
description: Chooses one of four fixed table entries for a 16-bit value using thresholds of 10, 20 and 50, then passes it to a helper. Values of 50 or more use the last entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:173A
name: call_tiny_threshold_bucket_entry
description: Selects one of three fixed table entries for a 16-bit value using thresholds of 10 and 20, then passes it to a helper with no return value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:174C
name: call_threshold_split_entry
description: Passes one of two fixed table entries to a helper, choosing the first when a 16-bit value is below 10 and the second otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:175E
name: call_fixed_table_entry
description: Passes a single fixed table entry to a helper and returns. It is a one-call wrapper around that entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:176C
name: fill_empty_slot_from_later
description: Finds the first of five slots whose byte value is 26 or more, then moves the first later slot with a value below 25 into it, copying its paired short and long fields and marking the source as free. It returns 5 when no slot is empty.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:182C
name: init_state_and_draw_rows
description: Allocates a state record through a helper, resets five slot tables and several byte fields to fixed starting values, then draws six rows spaced nine units apart and a frame at fixed positions. It returns the handle obtained at the start.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:198C
name: dispatch_keyed_glyph_or_table
description: Selects a helper and a table entry from a byte argument: values 17 to 19 use a secondary indexed table when a stored mode byte is non-zero, values below 36 use one table, and higher values use another with 36 subtracted. The chosen call's result is returned.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1A3A
name: step_window_entity_movement
description: On its first call it only sets a flag; afterwards it copies a five-by-five window of a sixty-four-cell grid into a scratch buffer, moves each marked entry to a free neighbouring cell, and writes the window back. It is the per-tick update of marked entries on that grid.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1D84
name: send_each_byte_of_buffer
description: Obtains a length from a helper for the pointer argument, then passes each byte of the buffer to a second helper in order and returns the last result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1DBC
name: reinit_record_and_return_status
description: Stores a status byte in a stack record, points a list head at a stored record, runs setup helpers on two regions, and restores the list head. It returns the status minus three, or the result of a further helper when that value is zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1E2C
name: fill_72_byte_table
description: Writes a seventy-two-entry byte table from several source bytes in fixed-size runs and sets a few individual entries. It returns 72, the table length.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:1F7C
name: read_bounded_text_line
description: Reads keystrokes into a buffer until Return or Escape, accepting printable characters up to a length limit and treating codes 8 and 240 as a delete. On Escape it returns zero; otherwise it null-terminates the buffer and returns the length.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2028
name: draw_layout_then_wait_key
description: Frees stored resources, then draws either a full layout of six by four grids with twenty-five entries each or a reduced layout, and loops until a helper returns a key. The decompiled text is cut off mid-statement, so the closing steps are not visible.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:24D2
name: draw_twenty_entry_menu
description: Draws a twenty-entry list at a fixed origin, reading each row's text pointer from a table; when the flag is set the table offset shifts by twenty, and the first row is spaced differently.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:25E0
name: compute_weighted_flag_bonus
description: Sums weighted flag counts (250 per set entry over eight entries, 500 over seventeen, 100 per entry equal to minus one), stores the excess over a stored value, then halves, doubles or quadruples it according to a mode byte and returns it.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:26A4
name: call_table_entry_after_setup
description: Passes two arguments to a helper, runs setup helpers on a fixed record and a data pointer, then fetches an entry from a two-dimensional table indexed by two stored bytes and returns that helper's result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2700
name: call_table_entry_with_args
description: Runs setup helpers on a fixed record and a stored pointer, passes the two arguments to a helper, then returns the result of a helper on the same two-dimensional table entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:275A
name: assign_unique_symbols_to_row
description: For each of up to five positions, reads a character through a helper, skips it when an earlier position already holds that character, and otherwise stores it with a converted value in a parallel array. It returns 5 once all positions are filled.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:280A
name: store_looked_up_handle
description: Calls a helper with a stored data value, saves the returned handle in a fixed slot, and returns zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:282A
name: call_helper_with_code_19
description: Passes the addresses of its last two arguments to a helper, then calls a second helper with operation code 19 and all four arguments, returning that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2830
name: dispatch_object_command_by_code
description: Switches on a small command code: several codes run fixed helper sequences, code 8 selects one of two stored objects, code 11 builds a grid object sized from the arguments, and code 12 draws the object. The decompiled text is cut off partway through the code 16 branch, so later branches are not visible.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2836
name: read_value_clear_sign_bit
description: Passes two local buffers to a helper, calls a second helper to read a value, and returns that value with the top bit cleared.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:283C
name: call_helper_with_code_10
description: Passes its two arguments with operation code 10 to a helper and returns that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2842
name: call_helper_if_nonzero
description: Returns zero when its argument is zero; otherwise it passes operation code 1 and the argument to a helper and returns that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2848
name: build_rect_and_call_library
description: Fills a 48-by-16 rectangle at the given position offset by three, stores a third value in the record, then makes two library calls on that record and returns the second result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:284E
name: format_padded_decimal_string
description: Counts how many table thresholds the value reaches, pads with a fill character up to a width capped at 24, writes a decimal digit from a helper for each position, and passes the resulting string to a helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2854
name: draw_beveled_box_frame
description: Draws a bevelled frame around a rectangle by issuing a series of line-drawing calls at offsets from the position and size, using three fixed pen values, then calls a library routine to finish.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:285A
name: lookup_cell_sum_when_one
description: Reads a byte from a twenty-five-column table at a row and column computed from the two arguments. When the byte equals 1 it adds the results of two helper calls and returns the sum, otherwise it returns the byte.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2860
name: run_fixed_helper_sequence
description: Issues four helper calls with fixed small argument sets in order and returns the result of the last one.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2866
name: acquire_record_and_call_helper
description: Walks a linked list of records to find one with a free field, or allocates a new 34-byte record, links it in and zeroes it. It then passes the two arguments and that record to a helper and returns its result, or zero if allocation fails.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:286C
name: draw_three_stacked_entries
description: Runs two setup helpers, draws three entries stacked nine units apart from a table of pointers, then issues two more helper calls and returns the last result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2872
name: step_repeat_countdown
description: Advances a countdown the given number of times: each step calls a helper, decrements a counter, and when it reaches zero reloads it from a stored interval and decrements a repeat count. It returns the last counter value read.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2878
name: fade_palette_toward_target
description: Steps a 32-entry colour table toward a stored target over sixteen passes, raising each entry's red, green and blue nibbles by one when they are below the target. After each pass it passes the table to a helper and waits, then returns 16.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:287E
name: advance_below_limit_by_helper
description: When the first argument is below the second, calls three helpers and adds the last helper's result to the first argument; otherwise it returns the first argument unchanged.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2884
name: translate_input_message_to_key
description: Reads an input message from a port and maps its class and code to a key value: raw keyboard codes go through a helper to a character, gadget and button messages yield fixed codes such as 27 for Escape or 32 for space, and other classes return zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:288A
name: set_mode_flag_call_helper
description: Accepts only the values 0 or 1: for those it stores the value in a state field and returns the result of a helper call. For other values it returns 1 without calling the helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2890
name: poll_for_value_in_window
description: Repeatedly reads a value through helpers, up to 1200 times, until it falls inside an eight-unit window computed from a stored position and the argument. It returns one if the value was found and zero otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2896
name: conditionally_transfer_and_store_value
description: When a stored flag is set, reads a four-byte and a two-byte value through helpers, looks up a result, and writes it back through further helpers. When the flag is clear it returns zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:289C
name: store_byte_call_helper_2
description: Writes its byte argument into a fixed offset of a state record, then passes operation code 2 and the argument to a helper and returns that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28A2
name: drain_input_messages
description: Repeatedly fetches messages from an input port until none remain, releasing each one through a helper. Messages whose class has the raw-key bit set also trigger a helper call with their code, and the function returns zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28A8
name: call_helper_with_fixed_one
description: Reorders its three arguments into a helper call with the second argument fixed at 1, and returns that helper's result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28AE
name: pick_weighted_entry_from_table
description: Draws a value from one to one hundred through a helper, then walks four table rows and returns the byte of the first row whose threshold exceeds the drawn value, or a final table entry when none does.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28B4
name: first_call_query_and_count
description: Increments a call counter; on the first call it queries a helper and, when a stored flag is set, issues a second helper call with fixed offsets. It returns the helper result on the first call and the previous counter value afterwards.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28BA
name: set_two_bit_mode_field
description: When the argument is below three, stores it in the low two bits of a state byte and keeps the other bits. It returns the state byte with those low bits cleared, or two when the argument is out of range.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28C0
name: release_four_stored_handles
description: Releases four stored handles through helpers, clearing each slot after its release. It returns the result of the last release.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28C6
name: dispatch_indexed_resource_call
description: When a mode flag is set, indices zero to nine each pass a stored resource and a fixed size constant to a helper and return its result. Other indices, and index zero under a second condition, fall through to a generic helper call.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28CC
name: draw_wrapped_aligned_text
description: Writes a string line by line, measuring each line and padding it for a two-bit alignment mode, centred or right-aligned, before drawing it through a helper. Consecutive newlines are passed through, and a line that would run past the right margin advances the row by eight.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28D2
name: call_helper_with_code_9
description: Passes its two arguments with operation code 9 to a helper and returns that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28D8
name: divide_unsigned_longs
description: Performs unsigned 32-bit division of two register operands using a normalised estimate and a correction step, returning the quotient and remainder as a pair. A divisor that fits in 16 bits takes a direct 16-bit division path.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28DE
name: fade_palette_to_black
description: Copies a 32-entry colour table from stored data and lowers each entry's red, green and blue nibbles by one per pass where they are above zero. After each of sixteen passes it passes the table to a helper and waits, then returns 16.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28E4
name: free_record_handle_and_release
description: If the argument is non-null, releases the handle held at offset eight of that record and clears the field. It then passes the argument to a helper and returns its result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28EA
name: call_helper_then_stored_handle
description: Passes its argument to one helper, then passes a stored handle to a second helper and returns that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28F0
name: fill_rectangle_via_library
description: Jumps through a stored library base to the graphics library's rectangle-fill routine, using the arguments the caller placed in registers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:28F6
name: allocate_slot_from_three_entries
description: Finds the first free of three 32-byte slots, stores four argument values in it with cleared fields and a set flag byte, and returns its address. It returns zero when all three slots are in use.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2902
name: multiply_longs_low_32
description: Computes the low 32 bits of the product of two register operands by combining 16-bit partial products, and returns that value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2908
name: store_byte_in_state_record
description: Writes its byte argument into offset six of a stored state record and returns the input register value unchanged.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:290E
name: decrement_counter_and_refresh
description: Decrements a counter; when it reaches zero it queries a helper and, if a stored flag is set, issues a second helper call with fixed arguments. It returns the query result at zero, or the input value while the counter is still above zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2914
name: call_helper_into_terminated_buffer
description: Stores a buffer pointer in a global, calls a helper with the second argument and a pointer to the stack arguments, terminates the buffer with a zero byte, and returns a stored result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:291A
name: store_byte_notify_handlers
description: Stores its byte argument at offset seven of a state record, passes it to one stored handler, and returns the result of a second stored handler called with the same byte.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2920
name: handle_text_editor_key_code
description: Handles one character code for a text line: code 256 redraws the cursor area, carriage return and line feed reset the column and step the row, and any other code is drawn and advances the column, wrapping to the next row past the right margin. It returns the current row.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2926
name: set_mode_call_helper_255
description: Calls a helper with 255, then with a stored byte, and returns the second result. It also sets a mode byte to 23 when the argument is zero and to 5 otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2932
name: store_cursor_position_fields
description: Stores its first argument in a state byte at offset four and its second in offset five. When the second argument is non-zero it first subtracts a stored base value and returns that base, otherwise it returns zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2938
name: chain_two_helper_calls
description: Calls one helper with no arguments, passes its result to a second helper, and returns that second result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:293E
name: clip_and_draw_extended_rect
description: Passes the addresses of its two coordinate pairs to a helper to normalise them, then calls a stored helper with the first corner and the far corner extended by eight units, returning that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2944
name: draw_fixed_panel_with_value
description: Clears, draws a fixed rectangle at decimal coordinates, sets a pen and draws its argument, then calls a helper with the constant 1000 and returns that result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:294A
name: draw_inset_rect_from_corners
description: Draws a rectangle from its four arguments, stores an inset version in a record three units in from the top-left and six units in from the bottom-right, and passes that record to a helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2950
name: branch_on_helper_result
description: Calls a helper with its argument; when that returns zero it calls a second helper with no arguments, otherwise it calls a third helper with two stored record addresses, and returns the result of the call it made.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:20:2956
name: mask_cell_indices_run_sequence
